description_en: Queries usage data for Web Application Firewall (WAF)
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn describe-dcdn-waf-usage-data --domain-name example.com --start-time 2018-09-30T16:00:00Z --end-time 2018-10-01T16:00:00Z --interval 300 --split-by domain --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDcdnWafUsageData

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name. If you do not specify this parameter, data for all accelerated domain names is returned
parameters.help_zh: 查询域名。若参数为空，默认返回所有加速域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据起始时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据结束时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The time granularity of the data, in seconds.

The value depends on the time span of the query. Valid values: 300 (5 minutes), 3600 (1 hour), and 86400 (1 day)
parameters.help_zh:
查询数据的时间粒度，单位为秒。

根据单次查询的最大时间跨度不同，该参数支持300（5分钟）、3600（1小时）和86400（1天）取值
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en:
The method used to group data. Valid values:

domain: groups data by accelerated domain name.

If you do not specify this parameter, the data is not grouped
parameters.help_zh:
查询结果分组方式。取值：

domain：按加速域名分组。

参数为空（默认）：查询结果不分组
parameters.name: split_by

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range

StartTime.description_en: The start of the time range
